Name: Groovelight
Description: Control Groovelight, the music player: play and pause, skip, see what is playing with its cover, and play a playlist, an album, an artist or the Album of the Day with one key
Author: Irwing Braga

Actions.Name: Play / Pause
Actions.Tooltip: Play or pause. Shows the play state over the cover of the song.

Actions.Name: Previous
Actions.Tooltip: Go back to the previous song.

Actions.Name: Now Playing
Actions.Tooltip: The cover, title and artist of the song playing. Press to play or pause.

Actions.Name: Play
Actions.Tooltip: Play a playlist, an album, an artist or what a search finds, shuffled if you like.

Actions.Name: Album of the Day
Actions.Tooltip: Home's Album (or Song, or Artist) of the Day, with its cover. Press to play it.
